Hi Katie — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick summary of options and we can flesh numbers after I sync with pricing/legal: 

Option 1 — Pilot (12 months)
- Target uptime: 99.9% (standard) with optional 99.95% premium add-on
- P1 triage: 15 minute SLA when on premium retainer; otherwise next-business-hour for standard support
- Retainer: monthly retainer covers priority routing, a named on-call contact, and escalation coordination
- Credit model: pro-rata token-based credits up to a quarterly cap (we typically cap credits at 2–3x monthly retainer to limit exposure)
- APAC: regional backfill available; APAC compute & failover add-on (+20–30% depending on committed capacity)

Option 2 — Commitment (2 years)
- 99.95% uptime available with a commitment discount applied to retainer + usage units
- Reduced retainer and lower credit floors; faster escalation-to-engineering SLA included

Open items I need from you to price accurately: expected peak concurrency (RPS / active sessions), monthly token/embedding volumes, and region traffic split. If you can send that I’ll return two line-item proposals by EOD tomorrow.

Grace / Jonas — drafting two concrete sketches below. I pulled typical thresholds from our recent commits and included suggested contractual language. See attached Pricing_Worksheet_v2.xlsx and annotated MSA redline comments.

High-level sketches (ballpark; final numbers require customer volume):

A) 12-month Pilot
- Premium Retainer: $18,000 / month (includes 24/7 priority routing, named escalation contact, 15-min P1 triage)
- Uptime target: 99.9% included; 99.95% SLA upgrade available as add-on (+$6,000 / month)
- Credit model: For incidents breaching SLA, credit = (monthly retainer / 30) * days_of_downtime percentage; quarterly cap = 3x monthly retainer
- APAC failover add-on: +25% on retainer for coverage and reserved capacity
- Discounting: pilot does not include volume discounts; one-time onboarding fee waived

B) 24-month Commitment (Conditional Discount)
- Premium Retainer: $15,300 / month (15% discount) subject to minimum committed ARR of $500k over 24 months
- 99.95% uptime included with reduced credit sensitivity; credit cap = 2x monthly retainer per quarter
- Escalation: Named engineering on-call with 2-hour SLA to engage if Ops triage escalates (we keep a reserved engineering buffer)
- APAC: regional surcharge +20% (reduced from pilot add-on)
- Legal: pushback items — limit credit exposure to monetary credits only (no set-off against invoices), explicit force majeure carveouts for regional network outages; counter their proposed broad confidentiality carveouts
Suggested concession framework:
- Start pilot at $18k/mo + APAC add-on if needed; if they sign 24 months and meet $500k ARR, retroactively apply 15% credit on the retainer for the duration of the commitment
- Keep credit cap language tight (monetary credits only, capped per quarter)

Next steps:
- Grace: confirm if they can share estimated monthly token/embedding volumes and region split (US/EU/APAC).
- Jonas: please flag any operational limits on guaranteed 99.95% in APAC (capacity & reserved pool) and confirm if we can provide the named-engineer escalation in market windows or requires dedicated standby budget.
- I'll prepare a term sheet and an SLA addendum draft; I recommend we keep MSA redlines minimal and move some items into the SLA addendum.
